items.program_or_pathway: Georgian National Film Centre Production Incentive
items.authoritative_corrected_state: Film in Georgia is a 20% cash rebate on qualified expenditure incurred in Georgia, with a further 2%-5% cultural uplift after the base certificate. The official programme page sets five one-point uplift criteria covering release/making-of, specified Georgian key personnel, Georgian cultural content, at least GEL50,000 Georgian post-production, and qualifying international distribution or festival recognition. Local-entity payment alone does not qualify non-Georgian expenditure.

items.program_or_pathway: Turkey Cinema General Directorate Production Support
items.authoritative_corrected_state: Foreign Film Production Support is selective support of up to 30% of the accepted amount spent in Turkey. The foreign producer must contract with an eligible Turkish co-producer or service company, which applies; the Turkish applicant must satisfy the official recent-production/service track record. The project must score at least 50/100 on the qualification test, be commercially exhibited abroad, and meet current minimum Turkey expenditure of TRY30 million for a feature, TRY6 million for a documentary, or TRY10 million per series episode. For co-productions, eligible Turkey expenditure is apportioned by the foreign producer's ownership share. Payment is made once after completion on invoices and a sworn CPA report. The support cannot be combined with co-production support.
